commentary_segments.text: The full schematic of the sigma-delta modulator is shown in this slide. The first integrator takes most of the current as it is designed for 6 pF sampling capacitors. The other two integrators only use 0.4 pF capacitors. Their power consumption is much lower. All commonmode output voltages are 0.5 V, whereas the input ones are 0.2 V. All switches are implemented as transmission gates. Despite the low supply voltage, sufficient V is available for all switches. Indeed, the threshold voltages are GS about 0.3 V. Vertical metal-wall capacitors are used with values of 1.7 fF/mm2. No horizontal capacitors were available.
